component.name: TextLink
component.description: An underlined inline link that navigates to a URL from within body text or a metadata line.

useWhen: Linking an author name, entity, or term inline within a paragraph or metadata line
Any inline navigational link embedded in body copy
When the link destination is a URL and browser navigation semantics (<a href>) are required

notFor.case: Using TextLink for an in-page action (e.g. 'Show more', 'Delete')
notFor.because: TextLink renders an <a> element. In-page actions that do not change the URL must be <button> elements for correct keyboard and screen-reader semantics.
notFor.note: Use Button variant='transparent' for low-emphasis in-page text actions.

useWhen.body-default: Standard inline link within body copy.
useWhen.body-small: Link within smaller supporting text (e.g. captions, footnotes).
useWhen.metadata: Link in metadata lines (e.g. lesson count, duration rows).
useWhen.label: Link in label-sized UI text (e.g. form helper text).

donts.case: Wrapping block-level content (Heading, Card, Stack) inside TextLink
donts.because: Interactive content must not contain other interactive content; block elements inside an <a> create invalid HTML.
donts.instead: Place the TextLink adjacent to the content, or use a card-level overlay link pattern with a separate invisible <a> spanning the card.

patterns.name: author-credit
patterns.useWhen: Naming an author inline, linked to their profile, followed by their role.
